verdict.rationale: vLLM publishes a formal Deprecation Policy that explicitly covers the OpenAI-compatible API server, CLI flags, configuration and public Python APIs. It defines a three-stage deprecation pipeline tied to semantic-versioned minor releases, with no removals in patch releases. Docs also gate behavior by release version (e.g. `required` tool_choice as of vllm>=0.8.3). Missing for 10: explicit API-level versioning such as path or header version contracts, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the policy is followed in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: This document outlines the official policy and process for deprecating features in the vLLM project.
Deprecations are tied to our minor (Y) releases following semantic versioning (X.Y.Z)
